# components.mjs

[Source](https://github.com/uol-library/spacefinder/blob/develop/assets/js/modules/components.mjs)

Dialogs (the information pages, and alerts) and the accordion

Sends sfpageshow and sfpagehide when an information page opens or closes.

**Exports:** `showPage`, `hidePages`, `openAlertDialog`, `Accordion`

<a name="Accordion"></a>

## Accordion
Accordion: a button (with aria-expanded and aria-controls) which shows and
hides the content it controls

**Kind**: global class

### new Accordion(domNode)

| Param | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| domNode | <code>Element</code> | element containing the button |

<a name="showPage"></a>

## showPage(page) ⇒ <code>boolean</code>
Shows an information page (used by routing.mjs, when the route is
page/<name>)

**Kind**: global function  
**Returns**: <code>boolean</code> - whether there is a page with that name  

| Param | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| page | <code>String</code> | page name |

<a name="hidePages"></a>

## hidePages()
Closes any information page that is open

**Kind**: global function  
<a name="getPageDialog"></a>

## getPageDialog(page, dialogid) ⇒ <code>A11yDialog</code>
Gets the dialog for a page, creating it if needed
(more than one button can open the same page)

**Kind**: global function  

| Param | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| page | <code>String</code> | page name |
| dialogid | <code>String</code> | id of the dialog element |
